messages.welcome:
Hi! I'm an automatic assistant/Bot made by Sic4rioDragon https://github.com/Sic4rioDragon/Steamchat-bot.
• Tell me briefly why you added me.
• Trades: Feel free to send a Steam trade offer. I don't do cash trades. If I'm actively trading CS2/TF2 items and the offer is fair, I'll accept.
• "Gift" trades (you send items without me agreeing to return anything) will be treated as gifts and **are not refundable**.
• If we know each other, say from where. Thanks!
messages.scamWarning: Suspicious link or pattern detected. This account does not accept cash trades or off-platform links.
messages.scamFinal: You have been detected and reported for sending a fake/scam message. You will now be removed from the friend list.
messages.langPleaseEnglish: Neither English nor German were detected in your message. Please write in English.
